standard.summary: 选择 hidden-state 前缀/后缀向量的初始化方式：normal、uniform 或 zeros。
standard.effect: normal 使用小幅正态分布，uniform 使用小幅均匀分布，zeros 从全零开始；未知取值会 fail-fast。
standard.whenToUse: 仅在 prelude 或 epilogue 长度大于 0 时需要设置；通常保持 normal。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要把初始化选项理解为论文 Prefix-Tuning 的 K/V 参数化或重参数化策略。

standard_en.summary: Chooses how the hidden-state prefix/suffix vectors are initialised: normal, uniform or zeros.
standard_en.effect: normal uses a small normal distribution, uniform a small uniform distribution, and zeros starts from all zeros; an unknown value fails fast.
standard_en.whenToUse: Only needs setting when the prelude or epilogue length is greater than 0; normal is the usual choice.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not read these initialisation options as the paper Prefix-Tuning's K/V parameterisation or reparameterisation strategy.

advanced.principle: 该字段只决定 lulynx 自研 hidden-state prompt embedding 的初始数值，不改变 post-forward 拼接位置与运行时契约。
advanced.intervention: 安装 prompt module 时初始化 embedding；配置层只接受 normal、uniform、zeros。
advanced.expectedImpact: 影响训练初期的附加 hidden-state 幅度，不改变参数量。
advanced.tradeoffs: zeros 初始扰动最小，但可能让早期梯度动态与随机初始化不同；应通过短测选择。

advanced_en.principle: This field only decides the initial values of lulynx's own hidden-state prompt embedding; it does not change the post-forward concatenation position or the runtime contract.
advanced_en.intervention: Initializes the embedding when installing the prompt module; the config layer accepts only normal, uniform, zeros.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Affects the extra hidden states' magnitude early in training; does not change parameter count.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: zeros has the smallest initial perturbation but early gradient dynamics may differ from random initialization; choose via short tests.
